answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent cracks one walnut of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. A pigment trail of who vouched for whom, watched sharp as a raven over the field, lets peers trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
